item.title: Permanent Labor Income Inequality and Stabilization Policies
item.description: Job market paper. How the distribution of permanent labor income shapes the transmission of fiscal and monetary policy.

item.title: From Income to Wealth Inequality: Trickle-Down vs. Capital Gains
item.description: How rising permanent labor income inequality feeds back on the wealth distribution through trickle-down and capital gains.

item.title: Fiscal Multipliers in Globally Solved HANK Models with Aggregate Risk
item.description: We globally solve HANK models with aggregate risk using deep learning, and ask how much aggregate risk matters for fiscal multipliers.

item.title: Deep Learning Solutions of Large Non-Convex Life-Cycle Models
item.description: We introduce a novel deep learning algorithm for solving large life-cycle models with both continuous and discrete choices.

item.title: Why Is There Still Investment in Polluting Capital? Stranded Assets and Climate Policy Uncertainty
item.description: A growth model with irreversible investment and capacity utilisation, where investment in polluting capital is consistent with expectations of a future bailout.

item.title: The Exit Channel of Monetary Policy
item.description: This paper studies the impact of rising interest rates on firm exit decisions.
